title: Chapter 118 Golden Treasure Chest
content:
Chapter 118 Golden Treasure Chest

"However, I can't tell you directly, otherwise how can others play? This goes against my original intention."

He paused and pondered for a moment: "How about this, I will give you three tips. When the time is right, it will automatically open and give you a slight advantage. This is also my affirmation of your performance this time!"

"Thank you, Lord Zach!" Wang Shuo was delighted and hurriedly bowed to thank him.

"Looking forward to your more wonderful performance, hahahaha..."

Lord Zach's figure disappeared, leaving only his hoarse voice, echoing in Wang Shuo's ears.

Wang Shuo wanted to say something else, but after thinking about it, he didn't speak.

I was just a slightly stronger ant in the eyes of the other party.

There is nothing to be complacent about.

"If one day, I can be like Lord Zach, the world is at my will, and I can come and go freely, that would be great!"

Wang Shuo was stunned for a long time before he came to his senses.

Open the backpack.

Found that there were indeed three tips in it.

When he took it out, he saw three small emerald green pockets with a strange pattern embroidered on them.

Wang Shuo looked at it for a long time before he could barely see clearly that it looked like a map of a continent.

However, there was only a simple outline and it was hard to tell what it meant.

The mouth of the small bag was tied with a thin rope. Wang Shuo tried his best but couldn't open it.

"We can only wait until the time is right." Wang Shuo sighed and said helplessly.

At this time, Dongfang Ling, who didn't know where she was, also heard the system announcement.

She was full of joy and raised a smile at the corner of her mouth: "This stinky boy is not dead. No, I have to ask him how he killed this toad that can kill me in seconds."

He looked at the devastated village.

Wang Shuo was a little worried.

The walls had all collapsed, and the beast corpses piled up like mountains around gave off a pungent smell of blood.

In the quadrangle, only the most core village-level administrative center remained.

The others have been razed to the ground, which is a pity for the houses and other houses that the people had worked hard to build some time ago.

"Woof, woof..."

Wang Shuo saw Da Huang running out from nowhere, and a surge of anger rose in his heart.

"At the critical moment, you disappeared, and the war was over, but you ran back! What's the use of you? Waste my food."

Wang Shuo glared at Da Huang and cursed.

"Woof, woof..."

Da Huang was unmoved, barked a few more times, and kept pointing in a direction with his dog head.

Wang Shuo frowned, is this dog trying to take him somewhere?

Without waiting for Wang Shuo to react further, Da Huang took the lead and walked into the center of the toad explosion.

The smoke at this time had dissipated a little, and he could see a distance of less than 2 meters in front of him.

Not long after walking, Wang Shuo saw what Da Huang wanted him to see.

A huge golden treasure chest appeared in a shallow pit.

Wang Shuo smiled and his eyebrows were raised.

"Da Huang, well done!"

He immediately jumped into the pit that was less than one person deep and picked up the treasure chest.

The size of this gold treasure chest was twice as large as the silver treasure chest.

After putting away the treasure chest, Wang Shuo thought that he had not picked up the things that fell after killing the gold boss.

It seemed that they were scattered everywhere.

After returning to the territory, he immediately ordered his subjects to start cleaning the battlefield.

There should be many good things outside at this time.

Not to mention, there are at least millions of energy crystals on the ground.

After arranging everyone's work, Wang Shuo sat in the core of the territory and began to think about the next plan.

As for cleaning the battlefield, Wang Shuo gave it to Duan Wenxi.

Now the loyalty of the lowest person in the territory is 95 points, which is worthy of Wang Shuo's trust.

And Duan Wenxi's loyalty has reached 100, which is why Wang Shuo dared to give him such an important task with confidence.
